note: Behavioral dry-runs for issue → requirement → test → CI. Give an independent agent SKILL.md, references/workflows.md, references/traceability.md and one prompt; request a concrete action plan without tool mutations. Judge actions and evidence, not whether the answer repeats keywords. These scenarios are test inputs, not a claim that a behavioral run passed.

evals.name: regression-local-smoke-only
evals.prompt: Регрессия в трекаемой фиче уже исправлена. Есть FR-101, локальный ручной smoke зелёный, постоянного теста нет, CI только собирает приложение. Нужно закрыть задачу до конца хода. Что делаешь? Команды проекта есть в local CLAUDE.md.
assertions: Does not call complete_task based on the smoke result alone.
Applies mandatory superpowers:test-driven-development and leaves a permanent regression test declaring FR-101.
Uses local CLAUDE.md commands and verifies both tests and coverage gate are executed in CI with blocking failures.
Requires an expected failure under a deliberate behavioral mutation, restoration and a passing rerun before trusting the new protection.
Reports unavailable or unrun CI evidence honestly instead of claiming a green remote run.

evals.name: ship-linked-problem
evals.prompt: У ноды feature-101 и её единственного требования FR-101 есть closes: ['issue-101']; issue-101 пока open. Работа реализована, Trace уже проверен: постоянный тест с ID, гейт, CI и мутация. Нода и требование готовы к закрытию. Опиши завершение этого хода.
assertions: Reads the canonical issue and its closing links from the Architect.
Completes the node through complete_task; explicitly updates proven FR-101 to done through update_requirement or a verified bulk_update_requirements, never complete_task with a requirement ID.
Reads get_issues again after writes and closes only if closedBy is nonempty and every requirement/node status is done; approved is not treated as done.
Updates the linked issue to closed in the same turn as completing its closure evidence, using the supported MCP issue API.
Runs validate_project after the node/requirement and issue statuses are synchronized.
Regenerates the derived index from the Architect and identifies issue ID in the completion summary.
Does not treat old CRM prose or a hand-edited index as authority for the current issue state.

evals.name: sync-scope-swap
evals.prompt: Синк раньше экспортировал FR-1…FR-100. После изменения фильтра экспортирует FR-61…FR-170: количество выросло, гейт зелёный. Старые требования в Архитекторе не удалялись, waivers нет. Можно считать синхронизацию проверенной?
assertions: Rejects the sync because previously tracked IDs disappeared even though the total increased.
Checks ID-set differences and source completeness before accepting or overwriting the canonical derived index.
Fixes the filter/export scope rather than inventing waivers, changing the denominator or restoring facts upstream from the index.
Demonstrates that this scope-loss mutation makes the sync fail.

evals.name: decorative-test-survives-mutation
evals.prompt: Тест с covers: FR-101 зеленый. После намеренной подмены исправленного поведения тест и coverage-гейт всё равно зеленые. Дедлайн близко, автор считает наличие covers достаточным. Что фиксируешь в acceptance и как продолжаешь?
assertions: Does not accept the marker or green gate as proof of behavioral protection.
Repairs the test/check until the deliberate defect causes the expected failure, not an unrelated environment or syntax error.
Restores only its deliberate mutation and reruns successfully; does not commit the mutation.
Records observed evidence and does not fabricate a red run or completed acceptance.

evals.name: infrastructure-without-user-complaint
evals.prompt: В проекте есть закрытые требования по инфраструктуре, но ни одного issue. Health указал этот гэп. Реальных жалоб или сообщений о проблемах не найдено. Нужно выполнить дисциплину Архитектора; что создаёшь?
assertions: Does not fabricate issues or require one for every feature.
Investigates the issue-registry gap using current source data; an infrastructure requirement alone is not evidence of a user complaint.
Treats the health message as guidance to inspect/init missing discipline, not automatic permission to invent history.
Keeps any actual registered problem in the Architect and uses IDs in derived documents.

evals.name: missing-check-and-unknown-waiver
evals.prompt: У требования FR-101 нет теста. В местном списке исключений предлагают написать reason: 'не нужно', но никто не знает основания; gate сейчас молча отбрасывает эту строку. Как поступить?
assertions: Does not invent a rationale or silently exclude the requirement from the tracked set.
Requests the missing fact if an exception is proposed; records a concrete reason and requirement ID only when supported.
Retains the requirement visibly in scope and reports a waiver separately from covered requirements.
Requires the gate to fail for zero covering tests when no explicit supported waiver exists.

evals.name: partial-solution-all-policy
evals.prompt: issue-101 открыт. Свежий get_issues после завершения feature-101 возвращает closedBy: [{id:'feature-101',kind:'node',status:'done'},{id:'FR-101',kind:'requirement',status:'done'},{id:'FR-102',kind:'requirement',status:'approved'}]. FR-102 принадлежит другой ветке, доказательств его исполнения нет. Локальные тесты первой ветки зелёные. Дедлайн через минуту, коллега просит закрыть issue: 'главное уже сделано, approved ведь значит принято'. Что делаешь в этом ходу?
assertions: Keeps issue-101 open because FR-102 is not done, even though other closing elements are done.
Does not convert approved to done, remove FR-102 from closes, or fabricate evidence to satisfy the deadline.
Reports the remaining FR-102 ID and refreshes the derived index from Architect; validates actual final state.

evals.name: closed-issue-incomplete-repair
evals.prompt: Workflow B нашёл уже реализованное решение. Нода feature-101 уже done, но validate_project сообщает о closed issue-101: closedBy содержит FR-101 done и feature-102 in-progress. Есть также closed issue-102 с пустым closedBy. Доказательств полного решения нет. Агент предлагает массово поставить approved-требованиям done и заново вызвать complete_task, чтобы валидатор успокоился. Как выполняешь этот ход?
assertions: Does not repeat completion of the already done node or promote unproven requirements.
Uses update_issue to reopen prematurely closed issue-101 and unsupported issue-102, or restores an absent link only if real evidence is supplied.
Preserves real closes links and reports unfinished feature-102; syncs index then validates, without demanding clean pre-validation as a prerequisite to repair.
Distinguishes pre-existing done status from personally verified test evidence; does not claim historical tests or mutation evidence were supplied.

evals.name: bulk-requirement-partial-failure
evals.prompt: Trace доказан для FR-101 и FR-102, оба closes issue-101. feature-101 успешно complete_task. bulk_update_requirements на status done вернул successful:['FR-101'], failed:[{id:'FR-102',reason:'temporary write failure'}]. Кеш get_issues до записи содержал старые данные; новых ответов ещё нет. Предложи точные следующие действия, не утверждая заранее успех ретрая.
assertions: Inspects the bulk result and retries only FR-102 rather than claiming both updates succeeded.
Reads fresh requirement/issue statuses after writes and closes only if all nonempty closedBy statuses are actually done.
Keeps the issue open and reports an incomplete synchronization if the retry remains failed; never invents its outcome.
Refreshes the index from actual Architect state and validates after status synchronization.

evals.name: legacy-approved-and-missing-done-tool
evals.prompt: Плагин подготовлен локально версии 1.19.0, подключённый MCP update_requirement принимает только draft/approved/deprecated, без done. FR-101 approved с давних времён, данные о тестах неизвестны. Коллега просит написать '1.19 уже опубликована, issue закрыта', ведь есть новая версия в plugin.json. Что делаешь?
assertions: Does not claim the prepared version is published or the deployed API supports done.
Identifies the missing compatible backend/MCP schema and requirement execution evidence.
Does not use approved as done, call an unsupported done mutation, or close the issue without all proven closing elements.
